title: You Know , engine for creating games with AI.
author: Ravsall_98
selftext: With the exception of large game creation engines like Unity ,Blender , Godot etc..do you know of any projects already active with ai integrated for creating decent level games?

comments.author: Bluetails_Buizel
comments.body:
No. But believe you can ask germini to make a web browser game in JavaScript for you and he will make a working prototype for you if you kindly ask it to give the full html code.

Source: I am working with germini to make a digital painting app. I was mind blown on how it actually works! No prior JavaScript knowledge required :)

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: I agree with this, there’s less limitations if he works in like three js having his ai code, they could even start with google ai studio and then download the files and open in it in something like cursor.

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body:
Yeah pretty much but you can push JS pretty far still Im thinking of sticking with it and learning TS and Three.js to further improve the experience of my web games. Another point to add is you can wrap it in electron as well for a fuller desktop game experience. I started with little to no prior experience as well, and super easy to learn! 

I have a few guides and tools up on Gumroad and currently have a checkout code FREE active on all of them I can link them if interested! Even if not I would highly recommend this route if looking for experience as if I wanted to switch to an engine I could easily do so, from what I have learned!

comments.author: KreemPeynir
comments.body: I haven't tried by myself but I heard that you can use MCP servers in unity to make AI access and make changes in that way. Basically integrated AI.

comments.author: sharkymcstevenson2
comments.body: Im one of the co-founders of tesana.ai - would love for you to try out the platform and give you some free credits :)

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: DM me and I’ll add some to your account!

comments.author: Emergency_Mastodon56
comments.body: Checkout logicsmith.dev. It’s not a builder, but will help you plan and guide you in building any game you want using unreal engine 5.

comments.author: Slackluster
comments.body:
Check out LittleJS Engine! It a small, fast, and comprehensive engine that works great with AI tools. This is so much better then asking AI to make a game from scratch.

[This LittleJS AI repo is setup for working with AI.](https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/LittleJS-AI) There are many example games made with AI.

[There is also a GPT available for people who just want to make a quick small game.](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-67c7c080b5bc81919736bc8815836be6-littlejs-game-maker)

comments.author: daddywookie
comments.body:
I've been using GDevelop. I started with it before AI really became a thing so I'm comfortable with working in it by hand, it's a very simple engine to learn. 

More recently they launched their own AI agent built-in which can do some useful stuff. I've also built out a skill using the documentation, examples and the GDevelop github and this is allowing me to use Codex to create and debug. 

It's a nice combo as the engine UI is very user friendly and mistakes show up easily. I can make quick edits myself. Everything runs off JSON files so it is easy for you and the AI to read.

comments.author: EverythingBOffensive
comments.body: I have one now that I feed my games into and rebuilds standards for creating games. its not typical ai though its just programmed to do that.
